name: Arabian Driftcore
subcategory: Illegal street racing and drifting-like phenomenon.
summary: Arabian Driftcore is a meme aesthetic combining images of cars performing " Saudi Drift " with the layering of a woman (typically a hijabi)'s eyes.
description: Arabian Driftcore is a meme aesthetic combining images of cars performing " Saudi Drift " with the layering of a woman (typically a hijabi)'s eyes. Images of characters like Jane from Breaking Bad are also jokingly used.
culturalContext: The creator of the Arabian Driftcore aesthetic is Emirati Flickr user Inamson1, who also went by the same name on DeviantArt. They were the one who made one of the most well-known Arabian Driftcore image back in 2013 and 2014. On October 13th, Inamson1 posted their very photo (as seen in the first image under the Origin gallery), which fits under this aesthetic. This image featured a pair of eyes of a woman overlaid above a drifting car, which set the tone for what would soon become the core elements of the aesthetic. Over the next few years, he continued to post several other photos in the same distinct style, all under the caption "Saudi Drift" on his Flickr account. Even though Farfoor Albaloushi had been posting these images for many years, it wasn't until 2023 that the aesthetic started to really get traction, with TikTok user @cressida.cretu posted a video about the aesthetic.…
